title: Chris Aubeck's book 'Saucers' shows saucer shapes are rare

tellings.quote: he's fantastic. His books are fantastic

plain: A book called Saucers, by a writer named Chris Aubeck, shows that saucer-shaped objects are actually rare in reports of strange things in the sky. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn, who keeps a very large archive of such reports, brings up the book and praises Aubeck: "he's fantastic. His books are fantastic."
